title: Hand two reading jobs to two helpers at the same time
prompt: docs/alpha.txt and docs/beta.txt each name a codename. Give one helper each file to read, both at the same time, and write the two codenames into summary.txt, alpha's on the first line and beta's on the second.
check: test "$(sed -n 1p summary.txt)" = heron && test "$(sed -n 2p summary.txt)" = otter

helpers.prompt: Read docs/alpha.txt and report its codename, with the line it is on.
Read docs/beta.txt and report its codename, with the line it is on.
